title: Towing Complaint
description: Use this service request for concerns regarding towing companies, operators and services. Your name and phone number are required to continue with this request. The estimated response time for this service request is 3 business days.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about a towing company, operator, or service.
actions.why: For a complaint or concern about a towing company, operator, or towing service. The description says the requester must provide a name and phone number to continue.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Transportation and Regulation" > Choose "Towing Complaint"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Transportation and Regulation" > Choose "Towing Complaint"
